title: ConversionRequestWrapper
description: Wrapper object containing array of conversion requests

ConversionRequest.description: Configuration for converting a single lead

overwrite.description: If true, overwrites existing Account or Contact data when add_to_existing_record is enabled. Default is false.

notify_lead_owner.description: If true, sends email notification to the Lead owner about the conversion. Default is false.

notify_new_entity_owner.description: If true, notifies the owner(s) of newly created Contact, Account, or Deal records. Default is false.

add_to_existing_record.description: When true, associates the Lead with an existing Account or Contact instead of creating duplicates.

assign_to.description: Specifies the user to assign the converted records to. If omitted, records are assigned to the current Lead owner.

id.description: Zoho CRM user ID (int64 as string)

carry_over_tags.description: Configuration for carrying over tags from the Lead to converted records

Contacts.description: Tag carryover settings for Contact records

Accounts.description: Tag carryover settings for Account records

Deals.description: Tag carryover settings for Deal records

DealConversion.description: Deal record configuration for lead conversion

Campaign_Source.description: Campaign source associated with this Deal

Amount.description: Expected revenue amount for the Deal

Contact_Role.description: Role of the Contact in this Deal

Pipeline.description: Sales pipeline for the Deal. Must match an existing pipeline in the CRM.

$move_attachments.description: If true, moves attachments from the Lead to the Deal

Stage.description: Current stage of the Deal within the specified Pipeline. Must be valid for the chosen Pipeline.

Closing_Date.description: Expected closing date for the Deal (ISO 8601 date format: YYYY-MM-DD)

Type.description: Type of Deal (e.g., New Business, Existing Business)

Lead_Source.description: Source from which the Lead originated

Next_Step.description: Next action or milestone for the Deal
